question: KD Jadhav has won the Olympics medal in which of the following sports?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Wrestling**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **KD Jadhav**, also known as **Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav**, was the first Indian to win an **individual Olympic medal**.
 
• He achieved this historic feat in **Wrestling** at the **1952 Helsinki Olympics**.
 
• Jadhav won the **bronze medal** in the **Bantamweight category** of freestyle wrestling.
 
• His achievement was especially significant as it came at a time when India was newly independent, showcasing the country's potential in international sports.
 
• He trained under **Rees Gardner**, a coach from the United States, and received significant support from his family and local community.
 
• Jadhav was known for his **agility, strength, and determination**, which helped him compete against some of the best wrestlers in the world.
 
• After his Olympic success, KD Jadhav became a symbol of **Indian pride** and inspired many young athletes in India to pursue wrestling.
 
• In recognition of his contribution to sports, a **stadium** named after him, the **Shri Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex KD Jadhav Stadium**, was established in Pune.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Weightlifting**__

 __
 
• Weightlifting is a sport where athletes lift heavy weights in specific techniques such as **snatch** and **clean and jerk**.
 
• India has seen success in weightlifting in recent years, with athletes like **Mirabai Chanu** winning medals at the Olympics.
 
• However, KD Jadhav did not win his Olympic medal in weightlifting.
 
 
 
• **Boxing**__
 __
 
• Boxing is a combat sport where two participants compete using their fists while wearing gloves.
 
• India has produced successful boxers like **Mary Kom** and **Vijender Singh**, who have won medals in international competitions.
 
• Although boxing is a popular sport in India, KD Jadhav’s Olympic medal was not won in boxing.
 
 
 
• **Shooting**__
 
 
• Shooting is a precision sport where competitors aim at targets using firearms.
 
• India has excelled in shooting with athletes like **Abhinav Bindra**, who won a **gold medal** at the **2008 Beijing Olympics**.
 
• Despite India’s success in shooting, KD Jadhav’s achievement was in wrestling, not shooting.
